title: About ViRaSPA
intro: ViRaSPA is a minimal, build-free single-page application framework built from vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
point1: No build step - plain files served by a small Node.js static server.
point2: Page/component lifecycle events, path-based routing and a responsive grid out of the box.
point3: Extend it with your own services, components and styling libraries as needed.
